notes: UNVERIFIED reading of the Pittsburgh Zoning Code (Title 9, Chapter 911 use table) by district family. Every value must be confirmed against the current Title 9 text before it is treated as more than an annotation. The ADU column depends on the 2025 accessory-dwelling ordinance and its overlay boundaries and must be confirmed in Title 9. R2 shows 'yes' for duplex_triplex because the two-unit type is by right there while the three-unit type is not. Where the family mixes districts with different rules (planned, riverfront, industrial) the more restrictive reading is used. This table is an annotation shown as 'unverified: confirm in Title 9', never a gate.
source: WPRDC Zoning Districts (City of Pittsburgh), resource 6127f35e-f36b-4a53-80b3-f4409609e9df, field zon_new; district codes read 2026-09-27

type_labels.senior: housing for the elderly / multi-suite residential

families.label: Single-unit detached residential (R1D-VL/L/M/H/VH)
families.note: One detached home per lot; housing for the elderly may be a special exception.

families.label: Two-unit residential (R2-L/M/H/VH)
families.note: Two-unit by right; three-unit is not.

families.label: Three-unit residential (R3-L/M)
families.note: Up to three units by right; multi-unit needs relief.

families.label: Multi-unit residential (RM-VL/L/M/H/VH, R-MU)
families.note: Multi-unit and housing for the elderly by right, subject to density subdistrict.

families.label: Hillside
families.note: Steep-slope district; residential allowed at low density with site review.

families.label: Local neighborhood commercial
families.note: Residential above or beside ground-floor uses by right.

families.label: Urban industrial
families.note: Urban Industrial admits multi-unit residential; confirm the current use table.

families.label: Riverfront mixed (RIV-MU, RIV-NS, RIV-RM, RIV-IMU)
families.note: 2018 riverfront code; RIV-IMU admits residential with limits.

families.label: Golden Triangle and Urban Center (GT-A/B/C/D/E, UC-MU, UC-E)
families.note: Downtown and Uptown: multi-unit by right, small types are not the pattern.

families.label: Parks and open space
families.note: Split from the planned/institutional family so park land reads 'no', not 'unknown'.

families.label: Planned, institutional and special (EMI, SP, RP, CP, AP, GPR, UPR, PUD)
families.note: Site-specific plans and institutional master plans: what is allowed depends on the approved plan.
